answer: Escrow deposits with a referral graph stop bulk fake identities. Each applicant locks 50 credits in a vault for 20 epochs and names a sponsor, slashed too if the newcomer cheats. A beacon lists every referral link, so auditors spot a star cluster pointing to one sponsor. Making 100 fakes costs 5,000 credits, far above the 200 they could earn in a season, while an honest agent pays once and keeps rewards undiluted, even in an ocean of applicants.
